“I'll stay hidden as close as I can, so just concentrate on saving Sakura. Once you do, even if you're one second away from being killed, I swear I'll save you.”

Tohsaka speaks as though making the promise to herself.

I accept her help knowing that, and Tohsaka is determined to keep her word knowing it too.

Resolve settles into the heart that anger had sent racing ahead.

I will rely on Tohsaka.

And in return, I will bring Sakura back unharmed. I have to.

The school building is deserted.

The recent wave of coma cases has forced the school to dismiss everyone early.

It is not yet six, but there should be no students left—not even any teachers.

Shinji is in the classroom on the third floor.

I nod once and break into a run.

—A bar of searing iron is already buried in my back.

My Magic Circuit has long since formed.

I tell my frantic heart that the only weapon permitted to me—Reinforcement—is not for defeating an enemy. I will use it to protect Sakura.

Sakura is Shinji's little sister.

An older brother is supposed to protect his sister.

Family is supposed to help one another, to laugh together.

So how did it come to this?

—What I failed to save—

How could a brother like him ever understand his little sister—ever understand Sakura's heart—!?

There is neither bloodlust nor hostility in her.

Obeying her Master's command, she advances toward me.

Fight Rider with my bare hands.

He may as well be telling me to die.

My bare body cannot withstand her. I have to Reinforce anything that might protect me, or she will tear off my limbs.

My left arm shudders where it guards my face.

The sledgehammer blow punches through my Reinforced uniform and goes to work on the arm beneath.

In a single breath, she has rendered both arms useless.

—No. They still move, but I cannot feel them at all.

With responses this sluggish, I can no longer block Rider's fists.

If she aims for my face, one blow will strip away my consciousness…!

Her cold precision calls to mind a machine built for nothing but striking.

All I can do is protect my head and keep her from taking my consciousness.

Whatever Rider makes of that decision, she does not attack the countless gaps in my guard.

Instead, she drives her fists into my exposed stomach and chest.

…Each blow is enough to double me over, but none carries the force that numbed my arms.

I do not know what happened to her. But if this is all the power she has—then I still have a chance to outmaneuver Shinji—!

The pile-driver impact gouges into my insides.

The wound in my stomach from last night, not yet healed, screams.

Acid rises into my mouth, and my legs begin to buckle at the knees.

Every place she struck is bruised and swollen, choking off the blood beneath. I no longer feel even the blows themselves.

The pain already filling my body is greater than the pain of being hit.

When it comes to destroying my flesh, Rider attacks without mercy.

The black Servant closes the distance, her voice empty of emotion.

それで、完全に思い知った。
これは慎二の意思じゃない。
俺の顔を狙わなかったのも、
俺がギリギリでまだ体を動かせるのも、
慎二に手加減を命じられたからではなく

pages.en:
And then I understand completely.

This is not Shinji's will.

She did not spare my face because he ordered it.

She did not leave me just enough strength to keep moving because he ordered it—

pages.ja:
「いいぞ、もう手加減はなしだ！ 殺せライダー！」
「っ……！？ 兄さん、やめ…………！」
pages.jaRuby:
「いいぞ、もう手加減はなしだ！ 殺せライダー！」
「っ……！？ 兄さん、やめ…………！」
pages.en:
“That's enough restraint! Kill him, Rider!”

“—!? Shinji, stop…!”

pages.ja:
ライダーは長い髪をなびかせて一歩踏み込み、
今までとは比較にならない一撃で、この胸を突き上げた。

pages.en:
Her long hair streaming behind her, Rider steps forward—

and drives a blow up into my chest with force beyond anything she has used before.

pages.ja:
「ご
」
息が出来ない。
地面の感覚がない。
あまりの一撃で、判っていても意識が掠れかける。
pages.jaRuby:
「ご
」
息が出来ない。
地面の感覚がない。
あまりの一撃で、判っていても意識が掠れかける。
pages.en:
“Guh——”

I cannot breathe.

I cannot feel the ground.

Even though I knew it was coming, the impact is so tremendous that my consciousness almost tears loose.
“Shirou…!”

pages.ja:
ライダーに吹き飛ばされ、宙に浮いている一瞬、くぐもった悲鳴と歓喜の声を聴いた。
……桜の声が、今までよりずっと近い。
pages.jaRuby:
ライダーに吹き飛ばされ、宙に浮いている一瞬、くぐもった悲鳴と歓喜の声を聴いた。
……桜の声が、今までよりずっと近い。
pages.en:
In the instant Rider's blow hurls me through the air, I hear a muffled scream and a cry of delight.

…Sakura's voice is far closer than it was before.

pages.ja:
落下する。
普通ならこのまま、背中から落ちて死ぬ。
落下の衝撃など要らない。
そもそも、人間を軽々と吹き飛ばすほどの一撃だ。
受けた時点で胸に風穴が開いてもおかしくない。
pages.jaRuby:

そもそも、人間を軽々と吹き飛ばすほどの一撃だ。

pages.en:
—I fall.

Ordinarily, I would land on my back and die.

The impact of the fall would hardly be necessary. A blow capable of tossing a human being through the air could easily have punched a hole through my chest the moment it landed.

pages.ja:
「…………、は」
だが生きている。
あれだけタイミングを合わせられれば、誰だって後ろに跳べる。
今のは殺す為の一撃じゃない。
顔を狙わず、なんとか体が動く程度に攻撃を留めたのは慎二の命令ではなく
あくまで、ライダーの意思だったんだから。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“…Hah.”

But I am alive.

With timing that perfect, anyone could jump backward with the blow.

It was never meant to kill me.

Sparing my face, striking only hard enough to leave me mobile—that was not obedience to Shinji's order.

It was Rider's own decision.

pages.ja:
「
せーの、」
間合いは万全。
床に落ちる直前に体を反転させ、ノータイムで姿勢を正し

“—One, two—”

The distance is perfect.

Just before I hit the floor, I twist in midair and recover my stance without losing an instant—

pages.ja:
「え？」
目の前にあるナイフの刃を、左手で掴み取った。
pages.jaRuby:
「え？」

pages.en:
“What?”

I seize the knife blade before me in my left hand.

pages.ja:
ナイフの刃を手の平で包む。
ざっくりと肉に食い込む感覚は、麻痺していたおかげで気にならない。

pages.en:
My palm closes around the blade.

Thanks to the numbness, I hardly notice the steel biting deep into my flesh.

pages.ja:
「え、え
！？」
残った右腕を振り上げる。
手の平が切れる事など考えもせず、
強く握り締めた右拳で、慎二の顔面を殴りぬいた。

pages.en:
“Wh-What—!?”

I draw back my remaining right arm.

Without a thought for the blade cutting into my palm—

I drive my clenched right fist straight into Shinji's face.
